newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed, trade light.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed, trade light.

text.p: Cash millfeed prices were mixed, with gains seen in the central U.S. and weakness on the east and west coasts, cash dealers said.
Traders said millfeed supplies were tight in several markets, but a lack of demand prevented sharp price increases.
"It is real thin (demand)," said a Texas dealer. "But there is nothing available either."
Some millfeed dealers said flour mills scaled back production, keeping millfeed supplies light. Some dealers said mills were running five to 5-1/2 days a week.
